title: The own mark of a body: dressed levels, clock spacings, inertia at second order

key_results.statement: The sector $(k,P)$ of the total contract, continued to real $P$ as $C_k(P)=\hat C^{(0)}+e^{-iP}\hat C^{(+)}+e^{iP}\hat C^{(+)\dagger}$, is fixed by places and by the total contract; its eigenvalues, their level differences, $P$-curvature and $\gamma$-coefficients are M6-invariant.

For couplings (a) and (c) the level-$k$ contract depends on $k$ only through $M_k$: exactly, $E_{k,\sigma}(P)=\mathcal E_\sigma(P;M_k)$, the dressed level of a clockless body with rest parameter $M_k$; this fails for the rest-only coupling.

The starting level is simple in its sector iff $\sigma\omega_k(P)\ne\sigma'\omega_k(P-Q)+E_{\rm exc}$ for all excited field states; then the dressed level exists, is isolated and analytic; sufficient at $P=0$: $2t_fN_f<M_k$ ($\sigma=+$), $4t_f\sin^2(\pi/L)>(M_k^2+\tau^2)^{1/2}-M_k$ ($\sigma=-$).

Under (6.4), $E_{k,\sigma}(P)=\sigma\tilde\omega_k(P)-2t_fN_f+\gamma^2\frac nL\sum_{q\ne0}\langle\beta_\sigma(P)|\hat V_q(z_q-C_k(P-q))^{-1}\hat V_q|\beta_\sigma(P)\rangle+O(\gamma^3)$ with $z_q=\sigma\omega_k(P)-\varepsilon_q$, $\hat V_q=M_k\sigma_3$ (a) or $\frac12[C_k(P)+C_k(P-q)]$ (c); $\sigma=-$ follows by $M_k\to-M_k$.

Under (6.4), own-mark cost at $P=0$: $\Delta_{k,\sigma}=-\gamma^2\frac nL\sum_{q\ne0}[M_k^2(2M_\sigma-\varepsilon_q)+\chi\,b_q^2(M_\sigma-\varepsilon_q/4)]/K_\sigma(q)$ with $\chi=0$ (a), $1$ (c); $\Delta_{k,+}<0$ for $2t_f<M_k$, $\Delta_{k,-}<0$ for $\tau^2\le2t_fM_k$; linear in $N_f$ at fixed $L$.
Held body ($\tau=0$): $E_{k,\sigma}(P)=\sigma M_k+N_f\varepsilon_0(\sigma\gamma M_k)$ exactly, with second order $-\gamma^2M_k^2N_f(L^2-1)/(12t_fL^2)$ for both branches and couplings.

Under (6.4) for $\sigma=+$, $P=0$ at levels $k,k+1$ (sufficient $2t_fN_f<M_k$): $E_{k+1,+}(0)-E_{k,+}(0)=(1+\gamma n)\delta_c+\gamma^2\frac nL\sum_{q\ne0}[G_+(M_{k+1},q)-G_+(M_k,q)]+O(\gamma^3)$; the first order is a common rescaling of the clock.

$\partial_M^2G_+<0$ (for (c) if $2t_f<m$, for (a) if $4t_f\le m$), so in the region $2t_fN_f<m$ (c), $2t_fN_f<m$ and $4t_f\le m$ (a), inside (6.4) for every level, the second-order spacing change strictly decreases with $k$: the own mark is not a common rescaling of the clock ($N\ge3$); at $\tau=0$ it is $-\gamma^2\frac nLS_0\delta_c(M_k+M_{k+1})$ for every $t_f$.

Under (6.4), $E''_{k,\sigma}(0)=\sigma\frac{\tau^2}{M_k}(1-\gamma n+\gamma^2n^2)$ (a) or $\sigma\frac{\tau^2}{M_k}(1+\gamma n)$ (c), plus $\Delta''_{k,\sigma}=\gamma^2\frac nL\sum_{q\ne0}\partial_P^2G_{k,\sigma}|_{P=0}$, up to $O(\gamma^3)$.

Under (6.4), leading order in $\tau^2$: $\partial_P^2G^{(a)}_{k,+}|_0=2M_k\tau^2(1+c)(1-M_k/t_f)/(\varepsilon_q(2M_k-\varepsilon_q))$, $\partial_P^2G^{(c)}_{k,+}|_0=-\tau^2(1+c)[2M_k^2/t_f+2M_k(2c-1)-\varepsilon_qc]/(\varepsilon_q(2M_k-\varepsilon_q))$, $c=\cos q$; $\Delta''_{k,+}<0$ there for $2t_f<M_k$.

Under (6.4) for $\sigma=+$ at $P=0$ (sufficient $2t_fN_f<M_k$), the change of the curvature inertia is not the change of the cost over $\tau^2$: for (a) equal at first order but not at second in the region $2t_fN_f<M_k$, $0<\tau<\tau_0(L,M_k,t_f)$, where the mark raises the inertia and lowers the cost; for (c) unequal already at first order.

Controls: for $\tau\to0$ (exact), $E''\equiv0$ and the spacing changes strictly decrease with $k$; for the rest-only coupling in the region $2t_fN_f<m$ (inside (6.4)) the spacings are unchanged at first order, change at second order without a common factor for $\tau>0$, inertia and cost over $\tau^2$ differ through second order ((a′) for $0<\tau<\tau_0$), and level $k$ is not dressed like a clockless body with rest parameter $M_k$.

definitions.name: Sector contract continued in the total label

open_issues: The upper level when field excitations reach the gap, and the limit L → ∞ at fixed n (own-mark cost growing like L), are not treated.
Records with κ > 0 (which break the joint translation) and orders above γ² are not treated.
The code checks only N_f = 1, so multi-object coincidences in (6.4) are not tested numerically.
The fall of the dressed body in the field of another source is left to a later package.

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions of G, E'', 1/E'' and M_k/τ²
Held body τ = 0: second order of N_f ε_0(σγM_k) from (4.2) of 04-profile reproduced by (6.6)
Branch sum rule: large-ε limit of (6.6) gives −⟨V_q²⟩/ε_q for both couplings
